svg.text: G1: the heap is a grid of equal-sized regions
collection set of a mixed GC
Region size 1–32 MB (power of two; up to 512 MB since JDK 18), chosen so the heap has ~2048 regions. An object ≥ half a region is humongous.
Each region has a remembered set of incoming references, so G1 can collect ANY subset of regions without scanning the whole heap.
Garbage-First: mixed GCs evacuate young regions plus the old regions with the MOST garbage, sized to fit MaxGCPauseMillis.
